question: Why do chat scrollbar arrows/thumb and wheel-over-text not move the retained history?
nativeConsumer: FFOne gameplay_ui chat input and ScrollPosition
acceptance: Real production UI hit testing drags the thumb and wheel scrolls over chat text.
Pointer capture cancels on release, focus loss, disabled chat and channel change; bounds and UI scale are respected.
Existing chat/localization tests pass and the development binary starts.

producer.command: .\target-build\debug\ff-client-editor.exe fusionforge dump-object-evidence primary ../builds/retrobution-20260821 main.unity3d 1564 --serialized-asset sharedassets0.assets --type MonoBehaviour --out work/projects/retrobution-ui-20260821.ffclient/reports/chat-scroll-owner.evidence.json

hypotheses.claim: The native scrollbar was decorative, with no Interaction component or pointer handler.
evidence: Native spawn/bind code; CnGuiChat.DoChatWindow invokes GUI.VerticalScrollbar behind bEnable.

hypotheses.claim: Chat text prevented viewport hover in Bevy UI focus processing.
evidence: bevy_ui 0.17.3 ui_focus_system stops on the first node with default FocusPolicy::Block, even when that text node has no Interaction. Native chat lines omitted FocusPolicy::Pass.

differences.detail: Uses existing scrollbar artwork and geometry. New input uses logical-coordinate drag, 10-unit arrow steps, 250ms initial/30ms repeat delay and 90% page steps. These internal Unity engine timing details were not re-exported; do not claim complete engine-widget parity.

conclusion: Restored mouse-driven chat history scrolling, including wheel-over-text. No native binary assets or localized strings changed. UI pointer acceptance passes on the production widget tree in EN/RU; full-client world smoke passes.

nativeContract.geometry: Shared track/thumb calculation for rendering and drag; source scrollbar x=log.x-21, width=16.
nativeContract.capture: Thumb preserves initial grab offset and captures until mouse release, focus loss, disabled/hidden chat, no overflow, cursor loss or channel change.
nativeContract.localization: No new visible strings, voice, font or asset changes. Existing keyed text is retained.

verification.result: 3 passed (pointer logic); final text focus handoff verified by real wheel input below
passed; preview subsequently rebuilt after fixture selection corrections
all four probes exit 0; real cursor hit testing and MouseButtonInput/MouseWheel events
600 frames, ordinary world/player/HUD smoke completed; no runtime errors

limitations: GUISkin 1368 serializes as MonoBehaviour and its engine MonoScript external library/unity default resources is absent. Strict skin dump correctly fails closed; no skin or texture payload is republished.
Weapon quick-cycle and right-click unequip already contain earlier fixes; this case does not re-accept their live-server behavior.
fixtureCorrections: The first probe evaluated clamp for non-overflowing viewports via eager then_some; changed to lazy evaluation.
Hidden/other scroll nodes must not be treated as chat: probe selects a positive-height overflowing viewport with the largest retained offset. Earlier failed probes are not accepted evidence.
